claude_only.name: Is the register-assigned identifier stable, reused after dissolution, or changed on conversion or migration?
When no register-assigned identifier exists, which fallback identity is used and how is it qualified?
How is the identifier syntactically validated before acceptance?
Which additional identifier schemes are recorded for this entity and which authority issues each?
Does each alternate identifier denote the same legal person, or a different unit such as an establishment, VAT group or branch?
What is the precedence order when alternate identifiers disagree with the authoritative register record?
How is a global identifier's own registration status reconciled with the underlying register record?
What is the legal name exactly as recorded by the authoritative register, including script, diacritics and legal-form suffix?
Which other names are recorded and how is each typed?
When did each name become effective, when did it cease, and what filing evidences the change?
Does the register enforce name uniqueness, and is the name reserved or in dispute?
Under which jurisdiction's law was the entity formed, at what sub-national level, and how is that coded?
What is the entity's legal form, expressed both as a local-language name and as a governed code?
Has the legal form changed over time, and what conversion event caused the change?
If no governed code exists for the form, which placeholder and free-text value are used?
What category and sub-category does this registration record fall into?
Which economic activity classification codes are recorded, under which scheme and version?
Is the declared activity self-reported or verified, and how often is it refreshed?
Does the category change the applicable registration rules or the meaning of other fields?
Which organization operates the register, and under what statutory mandate?
Which coded entry from a governed registration-authority list applies, and at what list version?
Does the register cover the whole jurisdiction, or only a sub-national or sectoral segment?
Is this source constitutive for registration, or is it consulted only to validate?
Does registration create legal personality, or record an entity that already exists?
Which particulars are opposable to third parties once disclosed, and from when?
What is the register's liability regime for inaccurate entries, and is the data warranted?
Are there parallel registers in the same jurisdiction whose entries could conflict?
What is the entity creation date, and how does it differ from the register's initial registration date?
When was the register record last updated, and when did we last observe or retrieve it?
What periodic confirmation or renewal obligation applies, and when is it next due?
How are date-only register values reconciled with timestamped ingestion records?
Which particulars must be disclosed at registration under the applicable law?
Which documents must be filed and how frequently?
What happens when a filing is late or missing, and how is that reflected in the record?
Which filings are publicly disclosed in full and which only as metadata?
What is the entity's status in the authoritative register and which code list defines it?
What is the status of the registration record as a data object, independent of the entity's legal state?
Which status transitions are legally possible, and which are terminal?
What supplementary status detail qualifies the headline status?
Are there active proposals to strike off, dissolve or suspend the entity, and when were they published?
Which filings are currently overdue and by how long?
Does the record carry flags for insolvency history, registered charges, or a disputed registered office?
What remediation restores good standing, and by when?
What type of legal entity event occurred, per a governed event type list?
What is the event's effective date in the jurisdiction, the date the register recorded it, and the time we ingested it?
What is the event's completion status?
Which documents validate the event and which fields does it change?
Is the operation a merger by absorption, a merger by formation, a division, a spin-off or a conversion?
Does the operation cross jurisdictions, and which registers must notify each other?
Does the entity's identifier survive the operation, or is a new one assigned and the old one retired?
On what date and on what ground did registered existence end?
Which insolvency or liquidation proceeding is open, who is the appointed office-holder, and what are its dates?
Can the entity be restored or reinstated, under what conditions and within what period?
What happens to the record and its identifiers after dissolution?
What is the legal or registered address of record and which components does the register mandate?
How does the registered address differ from the headquarters address and from operating sites?
Is the address usable for legal service, and is it a third-party or agent address?
Is the recorded address disputed, unverified or subject to change proceedings?
Is this record a branch or establishment rather than an autonomous legal person, and which head office does it belong to?
Which host-jurisdiction register holds the branch record and what identifier does it assign?
Which particulars must the branch disclose locally versus rely on from the head office register?
How is closure or dissolution of the head office propagated to the branch record?
Has the entity transferred its registered seat, from which jurisdiction to which, and on what date?
Is legal personality continuous across the transfer, or was the entity re-formed?
In which additional jurisdictions is the entity qualified or authorized to do business, and under what identifier?
Which identifiers are retired, retained or newly assigned as a result?
Which direct and ultimate consolidating parents are reported, and by which identifiers?
Over what period is each relationship valid, and which accounting or filing period does the evidence cover?
What corroboration level supports the relationship and which documents validate it?
If no parent is reported, which reporting exception applies?
How does this reported relationship differ from a statistical enterprise group?
Which mechanism holds beneficial ownership information for this entity?
What identifier links the registration record to the beneficial ownership record?
Who may access the beneficial ownership record, and on what legal basis?
How current must the linked information be, and when was it last confirmed?
Which officer or representative roles are recorded in the register, with what appointment and cessation dates?
What representation rule applies — sole, joint, or limited by class of act — and where is it stated?
How is authority to act evidenced for a specific transaction, and when was it verified?
Are any officer details suppressed or protected, and under what regime?
Which document evidences each registration fact, and who issued it?
As of what date do the extract's contents speak, and how long is it treated as current?
Is the document authenticated, and how is authenticity checked?
Is a translation or legalization required for cross-border use?
Which source was consulted to validate each field, and is it the authoritative register or a secondary source?
What corroboration level does the record achieve?
Which validation authority and which local identifier were used for corroboration?
How often must validation be repeated and what triggers re-validation?
Which discrepancies exist between the register record and other sources?
Is there a duty to report the discrepancy, to whom, and within what deadline?
What process corrects an erroneous register entry, and who may initiate it?
Which quality checks run automatically and at what thresholds?
How is an unresolved conflict represented so downstream consumers are not misled?
Which fields and documents are public without restriction, and which require registration, fee or a legitimate-interest test?
Which categories of requester are recognised and how are they authenticated?
What licence or reuse conditions attach to the disclosed data?
What must be logged when restricted content is accessed?
Which fields in the registration record contain personal data, and whose?
Which suppression, protection or redaction regimes are available, and how are they flagged?
Can a data subject obtain erasure or restriction, and what is the settled position?
How is personal data handled when the record is redistributed or cached downstream?
From which source system, endpoint or file was each fact obtained, and at which version?
What are the event time, the register's recorded time and our observation time for each fact?
Which agent performed the retrieval and under what authorization?
How is the retrieved payload preserved so the assertion can be re-checked later?
Which historical versions of the record are retained and at what granularity?
For how long after dissolution must the record be retained, and by whom?
Under what circumstances may data be deleted or de-published, and what tombstone remains?
How are retention conflicts between register duties and privacy demands resolved?
Which external vocabularies and schemas is this model aligned to, and at which versions?
Which fields map cleanly, which map with loss, and which have no counterpart?
Which register-to-register or downstream exchange protocols must be supported, and what message types do they define?
Where do external models conflict semantically, and how is the conflict recorded rather than hidden?

grok_only.name: Does this subject have legal personality distinct from its members or controllers under the law of the formation jurisdiction?
Which capacities does the law confer on this legal person, and are any of them restricted by statute, objects or duration?
Are members or shareholders shielded from the entity's debts solely by reason of membership, and under which legal form rule?
At what event time did legal personality attach, and is registration constitutive or merely declaratory in this jurisdiction?
Which ISO 17442 / GLEIF entity category and, if any, subcategory describe this registered party?
Is the subject a natural person in a private capacity and therefore outside this model, or a sole trader or similar business-capacity registration?
If the subject is a partnership, association, fund or government body, does the formation law confer legal personality or only a register entry without personality?
What is the official legal name as recorded in the authoritative register or constituting instrument, in which language?
Which transliterated, previous, trading or additional registered names apply, and over which validity interval?
Does the name satisfy jurisdiction rules against misleading form, public-policy conflict and collision with existing registered names?
What identifier did the authoritative formation or licensing register assign, and which GLEIF Registration Authority code identifies that register?
Does the entity have an ISO 17442 LEI, an EU EUID, and/or other governed identifiers, and which is used for which interoperability plane?
Has uniqueness been preserved (one LEI per entity), and if the LEI was ported, which LOU now maintains it without changing the code?
If no authoritative register or LEI identifier exists yet, which UUID or ULID has the adopting Dimension assigned as a provisional key?
Which legal jurisdiction constituted this entity, at country and, where relevant, subnational level?
If the entity was created abroad, does this operating jurisdiction assert sufficient FATF links requiring basic or beneficial-ownership information to be available here?
Which law governs internal affairs, and is the registered office required to be in that same jurisdiction?
What ISO 20275 ELF code and native-language legal-form label apply in the formation jurisdiction?
Has any mapping claimed that this legal form is equivalent to a form in another jurisdiction, and is that mapping marked as non-normative?
If no ELF code exists, what OtherLegalForm text is recorded and has a code-list gap been raised with the maintenance agency?
Is a reserved RA code in use because no ordinary register exists, and what public legal document or exception justifies it?
If the validation authority differs from the registration authority, which authority corroborated the record and to what level?
Has a company file been opened in the register, and what is the file or registration number used for filings and disclosure?
What is the company's EUID, and which country code, register identifier and domestic number compose it?
Which alternate identifiers, including any LEI, are attached to BRIS notifications for this company?
Which BRIS notifications (branch disclosure, cross-border merger or other) have been sent or received for this entity, and when?
Which constituting instruments (instrument of constitution, statutes, articles, organisation rules) are on the register file, in which language and at which version?
What objects, capital (authorised and subscribed) and duration does the constituting instrument state?
Which directors, legal representatives or designated managers are disclosed as authorised to bind the entity, and what are their powers and appointment interval?

Does the company keep a register of shareholders or members (names, shares or interests, classes and voting rights), and is it held at the registered office, another notified location, or only abroad because beneficial-ownership information is held in-country?
What is the registered office or legal address of formation, including country and subdivision, and is it the address for service?
What is the headquarters address if different from the legal address, and in which language was the source address recorded?
When did a change of registered office become effective in the formation jurisdiction, and when was it disclosed on the register?
Which branches or international establishments are registered, in which host registers, and under which host identifiers?
Does the host or home law treat this establishment as a separate legal person, an international branch eligible for its own LEI, or only a register object of the parent company?
If the company was dissolved or wound up, has each registered branch been struck off without undue delay, and at what event time?
On what date and time, with which offset, was the entity first established in the formation jurisdiction?
When was the LEI or national registration first assigned or published, and when was this data record last updated and why?
Was the entity formed through an online procedure, paper filing, statutory instrument or public legal document, and who submitted the application?
What is the legal-entity status, what is the identifier registration status, and are they being kept distinct?
If the entity ceased to exist or operate, what is the expiration date-time, the expiration reason, and the successor if any?
Has winding-up, a judicial declaration of nullity, or appointment of liquidators been disclosed, and what powers do the liquidators have?
Has a completed liquidation or insolvency event required the LEI RegistrationStatus to become RETIRED while still allowing quality amendments?
Which legal-entity events are recorded, with which type, status, effective time in the formation jurisdiction, and observation time?
Was conversion, restructuring or dissolution decided by the members (or competent court) as required, and is that decision on the register file?
Against which validation authority and at which validation-sources level was this record corroborated?
Which data-quality issues, challenges or lapsed-renewal states are open on this record, and who raised them?
Do any publisher extensions exist, and can the standard identification content be interpreted if they are ignored?
Is the FATF paragraph 4(a) basic set complete on the company registry and available as public information?
Which prongs of the multi-pronged approach are in use, and which public authority or alternative mechanism holds beneficial-ownership information?
Who may access basic information, the legal-owner register, and beneficial-ownership information, under which legal basis, and are there privacy or security exceptions?
Does the entity have existing bearer shares or nominee shareholders or directors, and which mitigation measures apply given that new bearer shares must not be issued?
When did the five-year FATF retention clock start (dissolution, cessation of existence, or end of customer relationship), and is a longer legal-certainty archive also in force?
Which particulars are available free of charge through the register or BRIS, and which copies may be charged only at administrative cost?
May third parties rely on the disclosed instruments and translations, and are there known discrepancies between authentic and translated versions?

requirements: Resolve every provider-only bundle, layer and finding against primary evidence.
Resolve the model boundary and entry kind before accepting structure.
Verify live URLs and version pins for all accepted sources.
Record every rejected and deferred node with a reason.
Do not publish while any critical conflict remains unresolved.
